message.content:
A vertical magazine cover features a dark red background with an illustration of a rat dressed in academic regalia. The rat has grey-brown fur, a long thin tail, and a pointed snout. It wears a black graduation gown, a mortarboard cap with a yellow tassel, and a yellow stole. It stands atop the highest of five graduated stacks of United States one-hundred-dollar bills. The stacks increase in height from left to right. The rat holds an open, blank, light-grey diploma in its black-gloved hands.

Large white text at the top reads “TEMPO” above “50 Tahun!”. Smaller white text above this reads “POLITISASI BADAN RISET NASIONAL” and “KEMBANG KEMPIS SELEPAS CHEVRON”. Bold white text on the left states “OBRAL DOCTOR HONORIS CAUSA”. Below this is smaller white text: “Perguruan tinggi dituding serampangan menebar gelar doktor kehormatan. Jadi bancakan ketua umum partai hingga hakim agung.” At the bottom left, a barcode, a QR code, and details including “15-21 FEBRUARI 2021” and “RP 45.000” are visible. A thick red band runs down the far-left edge.
